subject: ResellCo CPPO entitlement provisioning & portal readiness - runbook
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@resellco.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: enable CPPO & entitlement mapping for ResellCo launch

Hi Mateo,

Hope youre well. Were finalizing the commercial paperwork for ResellCos first CPPO launch and need Redwood to: 1) provision the two entitlements (SKU: RW-Dedicated-100, RW-Hosted-Std) in the AWS private-offer portal under our reseller account, and 2) confirm the billing entity mapping so our finance team can issue a single consolidated PO.

Attached: ResellCo_SOW_v2.pdf (scope) -- Ive also attached a draft PO (will be final after you confirm billing entity). Can you confirm the list of Redwood product SKUs you need for the CPPO and any required account IDs? Also please share the fastest path for us to get portal access and entitlement provisioning.

Wed like to go live the week of 6/28 if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Channel Ops, ResellCo
Elena.torres@resellco.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: ResellCo_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@resellco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: enable CPPO & entitlement mapping for ResellCo launch

Hi Elena

Thanks for the SOW and initial PO. We can support the 6/28 target but need a short runbook to keep us on track. Below are the items we need to close this week:

1) Entitlement mapping template (attached) - please confirm which of the two SKUs map to your AWS listings (and AWS account IDs).
2) Billing entity & tax info - ResellCo legal name + remit-to address + tax ID.
3) DocuSign route for SOW/PO (Ben will coordinate invoicing).
4) Reseller console access - we need an AWS Marketplace partner account ID to add entitlements.

Action owners:
- Mateo: coordinate entitlement mapping & portal provisioning once we have partner account ID.
- Ben Carter: handle invoicing path and DocuSign wiring.
- Tessa Morgan: run enablement + demo and validate entitlement behavior in staging.
- Laura Bennett: confirm procurement checklist and any legal prerequisites.

Can you send the partner account ID and the signed PO (or confirm theyll route via DocuSign) by EOD Friday 6/18? Im attaching a quick CSV template (resellco-entitlement-mapping.csv) you can fill.

Best,
Mateo
Sr. Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com

Attachments: resellco-entitlement-mapping.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@resellco.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-13T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: enable CPPO & entitlement mapping for ResellCo launch

Elena,

Quick follow-up on billing. To route the PO into our billing system for a CPPO we need:
- Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the invoice
- Remit-to address and VAT/Tax ID (if applicable)
- P.O. number and preferred invoice cadence (net 30 / net 45)

If you want the invoice to be payable to Redwood or to our partner entity (ResellCo gets credit), say so and well map accordingly. We typically accept DocuSign envelopes for SOW/PO. If you prefer your procurement portal, we can accept a PDF PO but need the final signed copy before provisioning.

Also: is ResellCo requesting consolidated monthly invoices or individual invoices per end-customer? This changes how we set up entitlement reporting.

CCing Laura to ensure any legal redlines are surfaced early.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood
ben@redwood.com

Mateo / team,

Following up to set the enablement timeline given the PO confirmation. Plan below:
- 6/16: Add ResellCo partner ID to staging marketplace and provision SKU entitlements for validation. (owner: Mateo)
- 6/18: Tessa run staging demo with ResellCo (validate grant/consume flows, entitlement reporting).
- 6/21: Provision production entitlements in CPPO portal and flag for billing mapping.
- 6/28: Go-live (marketing/CS notified).

Notes: the staging demo will include a quick script that covers quantified acceptance criteria: entitlement shows in 5s for an authenticated call; billing usage appears in the reporting CSV within 24 hours. Please confirm any additional acceptance criteria.

Elena / Team,

All set on our side. Summary / commitments: 
- Mateo: will complete staging provisioning 6/16 and run the entitlement validation checklist.
- Tessa: will lead the staging demo 6/18 (invite sent to Elena, ResellCo has confirmed availability).
- Ben: will process the consolidated monthly invoice mapping and confirm DocuSign envelope routing by 6/18 EOD.
